npcs.note: Ombrask Arcane Shade Militia commander specializing in evidence wards, midnight warrants, and containment logistics (Eldryssar, Vaelmyrith; pronouns: they/them). Use Veyl to make law, secrecy, and arcane evidence dangerous without making the party villains by default.

npcs.name: Vellum Tekt
npcs.description:
Vellum Tekt is a fast-talking Satyr salesman with old-world polish, nervous charm, and the hollow-eyed exhaustion of someone who spent decades selling safety he was never allowed to receive himself. As a Thalunesh-touched Satyr, he masks trauma with jokes, brochures, rehearsed optimism, and theatrical friendliness, but every locked door and denied refuge still lives under his smile.
At the Eldryssar Clinic, Vellum now works with the Regent Lattice selling bunker berths, reinforced shelter contracts, evacuation ledgers, and “future-proof” survival packages to families afraid of divine breaches, ichor contamination, and civic collapse. He is irritating, pitiable, surprisingly useful, and desperate to matter again—especially if someone gives him a real settlement post instead of treating him like a relic from a failed sales pitch.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Eldryssar is a Capital City in Vaelmyrith, under Council Republic, with elevated danger, Prairie, Beach and grass with water, Farming terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Satyr reads through the Satyr entry of the race compendium, within Fey and Trickster Folk, marked by Thalunesh. Satyrs are goat-legged fey known for revelry, music, and indulgence in natural pleasures. They often serve as companions of wilderness spirits and chaotic celebration. Table cues: Fey, Ram, Magic Resistance, Mirthful Leaps; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Cooperative - Neutral.
rumors: Vellum Tekt knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Anubaday.
Vellum Tekt has a contact in Bronzewake who will deny everything.
